screens._note: The character screen (D239 to D241): its layout and pieces come from scripts/art/ui/character_screen.mjs, the item pictures are the pack pictures (D237), the fonts Alegreya (OFL 1.1). The HUD (D244 to D246): hud.json and its pieces from scripts/art/ui/hud.mjs --pieces. The death screen (D247): death_screen.json and its pieces from scripts/art/ui/death_screen.mjs --pieces. The loot window (D248): loot.json and its pieces from scripts/art/ui/loot_window.mjs --pieces. The Reputation screen (D249): reputation.json and its pieces from scripts/art/ui/reputation_screen.mjs --pieces.

character._note: How a character is drawn (D121, D205, D227). Every number is a setting (D175), none of it final. The Creator's parts are drawn in grey (185 of 255, grey_ref): a tint replaces the grey. Sizes and skin colours are in looks.json, the parts and their colours come in the view. walk_fps is frames a second of Walk, one rate on every side (D227): the test game's SE straight-step rate for a human, ground speed / (foot_px_per_frame * sprite_scale) = (hypot(tile_px[0] / 2, tile_px[1] / 2) / 0.3 s a tile) / (3.1 px a frame * 2.5) = 238.5 / 7.75 = 30.78; snap_tiles is how far off its tile a character may be drawn before it jumps there.

layer_order._note: Back to front, per direction, by slot. The sword is in the right hand and the shield on the left arm, so the one on the far side of the body is drawn behind it. Where the shield's face shows (S, SW, W, NW) it is drawn over the hands. A cloak or pack (back) is behind the body unless the character faces away.
